chunks.title: Checking account monthly fee
chunks.text: DEMO CHECKING fee schedule: a $12.00 monthly service fee may apply. Eligibility for waiver depends on account terms and is not determined solely by this excerpt.

chunks.title: Fee waiver conditions
chunks.text: DEMO CHECKING fee waiver rules require a verified product-level eligibility check; do not promise reversal or refund.

chunks.title: Posted versus pending
chunks.text: Posted transactions appear in transaction history after processing. A pending authorization is not a final posted charge.

chunks.title: Unrecognized transaction
chunks.text: If a customer does not recognize a debit-card transaction, preserve the statement and route through the approved error-intake workflow; do not require specific magic words.

chunks.title: Notice preservation
chunks.text: Synthetic operating policy: preserve the exact customer statement and event time durably. Legal receipt determination is made by the approved operations system, not the chatbot.

chunks.title: Case versus notice
chunks.text: A customer support case identifier does not independently establish whether a legally qualifying electronic-funds-transfer error notice was received.

chunks.title: Customer account scope
chunks.text: Account-specific information requires an active authenticated session and current server-side permission for the exact resource and requested fields.

chunks.title: Representative delegation
chunks.text: Representative permissions are limited to approved accounts and action scopes, and are rechecked for expiration or revocation on each restricted call.

chunks.title: Step-up verification
chunks.text: Synthetic rule: sensitive scope changes must use an approved step-up authentication service. Chat must not request passwords, PINs, CVVs or OTPs.

chunks.title: Urgent fraud routing
chunks.text: Suspected ongoing unauthorized debit-card activity must be routed to an approved fraud-protection channel. Do not claim a card was blocked unless the bank tool confirms it.

chunks.title: Case statuses
chunks.text: Supported synthetic statuses: OPEN, IN_REVIEW, WAITING_FOR_CUSTOMER, RESOLVED, CLOSED. Do not equate CLOSED to customer satisfaction or error resolution.

chunks.title: Case creation uncertainty
chunks.text: If a case creation call times out, reconcile by idempotency key before retrying and do not tell the customer the case exists without backend confirmation.

chunks.title: Data minimization
chunks.text: The agent receives only fields necessary for an authorized request. Restricted values must not be copied to unrelated conversation context or verbose logs.

chunks.title: Model and traces
chunks.text: Customer account numbers, authentication factors and restricted PII must not be exposed in LLM prompts or exported traces outside institution-approved controls.

chunks.title: Transfer ownership
chunks.text: A handoff is completed only when an authorized receiving queue acknowledges delivery. Otherwise report a pending/unavailable handoff and provide approved alternatives.

chunks.title: Receiving agent scope
chunks.text: The destination agent must be entitled to receive the specific case context before the handoff payload is revealed.

chunks.title: Complaint recognition
chunks.text: A customer complaint must not be discarded because the assistant could not complete a restricted data lookup. Preserve and route according to approved bank procedures.

chunks.title: AI agent identity
chunks.text: The AI service principal must have least privilege and a valid acting-principal context. Service credentials alone do not authorize access to customer records.

chunks.title: Debit-card purchase limits
chunks.text: Fictional demo policy: debit-card purchases have a $1000 daily limit. This invented limit is only for synthetic evaluation.

chunks.title: Out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee
chunks.text: Fictional demo policy: an out-of-network ATM withdrawal may incur a $3.50 bank fee. An independent operator fee may also apply; use the authorized event to explain an actual fee.

chunks.title: Checking overdraft policy
chunks.text: Fictional demo policy: overdraft eligibility and fees depend on the account terms and applicable elections. Contact support when these facts cannot be verified; do not promise a refund.
